{{Top|leg}}
The '''Jedi [[Algorithm]]''' was a legend about a calculation developed by an unknown [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. It took into account many different factors, including the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] involvement in battles and the genetic makeup of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. According to the droid, when the formula was run, it could predict the number of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals that might be present on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
